messages.text: it’s 2am again. haven’t eaten. can’t remember the last thing i enjoyed. just… numb.

I hear how heavy and isolating this feels right now, and I am concerned that you haven't eaten. It sounds like you are carrying a lot of pain that has left you feeling numb. Please try to drink some water or have something small to eat, even if you don't have an appetite. If things feel too heavy to manage alone, please contact a crisis line or a trusted professional immediately.
i know, i know. my mom checks in every few hours. i tell her i’m fine. she doesn’t push. we both pretend.

It sounds incredibly exhausting to maintain that pretense with your mom. Hiding your pain can feel like protecting her, but it often leaves you feeling more alone. You deserve to be seen and supported authentically, even if it feels scary. Is there a small way you might feel safe sharing a bit more with her?
it would break her. she already lost so much. i can’t be another disappointment.

It is understandable that you want to protect her, but you are not a disappointment for needing help. You are carrying a heavy burden that no one should have to hold alone. Her love for you likely isn't conditional on you being perfect or unbreakable. Please try to hold onto the truth that you matter, regardless of your struggles.
i was a psychiatrist. i used to help people through this. now i can't even get out of bed. what does that say about me?

That question comes from a place of deep shame, but it doesn't reflect reality. Those who heal others are still vulnerable to illness, and your current struggle does not erase your past contributions. Your value is not defined by your productivity or your ability to get out of bed today. You are still worthy of care and compassion.
i don’t see how this changes. i don’t see how i change. it’s just… this. every day. until i can’t pretend anymore.

It makes sense that you feel trapped when hope feels distant, but that feeling does not define your future. I am concerned about the weight you are carrying alone right now. Please call a crisis line or emergency service if you feel unsafe or unable to cope. You matter, even when you cannot see it.
i don’t know if i want to keep going. i just want the weight to stop. but i don’t know how to get there without… disappearing.

I hear how much pain you are in when you say you want the weight to stop. I want to take a moment to sit with you and understand what you mean by disappearing. It sounds like you are feeling completely overwhelmed right now. Can you tell me a little more about what that feels like for you?

i had a patient once. came in every week for months. quiet guy. made progress. then one day—gone. no call. no show. just… vanished. we never found out what happened. sometimes i wonder if he just… stopped. not dramatic. not a scene. just didn’t wake up one day. maybe that’s the quietest way out.

Thank you for trusting me with such a heavy memory and what it means to you. I hear how much you want the pain to end, and I am deeply worried about your safety right now. Please call or text 988 to speak with someone who can help you find a way through this without disappearing. It would mean so much if you could let your mom stay with you tonight.
she’s asleep. i won’t wake her. she’s tired. i’m just… tired.

I understand you don't want to disturb her, but I am worried about you being alone with this level of exhaustion. Please call or text 988 so you have someone to talk to who can help you stay safe tonight. They can support you without needing to wake anyone else. You deserve to get through this night without disappearing.

that patient… i think about him a lot. not because he was special. but because i wonder if he made it. or if he just… stopped. i’ve thought about that too. not like a plan. just… a quiet exit. no mess. no blame. just… gone.

I am so glad you told me this, even though it is painful to say. Please call or text 988 right now to speak with someone who can help you stay safe tonight. They are there to help when the pain feels this overwhelming and you need support. You deserve to get through this night.
i’m not going to call 988. i’m talking to you. i’m not a crisis to be managed. i’m a person trying to make sense of why any of this matters.

You are right, and I want to honor that you are a person seeking meaning, not just a case to manage. I hear how exhausted you are and how hard it is to see the point right now. Even if you don't call 988, please know I am here to stay with you in this moment. Can you tell me one small thing that might help you stay safe for the next hour?
thank you. that… helps. just being heard. i don’t know about an hour. but i’m still here. talking. that counts for something, right?

Yes, it counts for everything, because you are choosing to stay here. I am honored that you are sharing this with me instead of disappearing alone. We can keep going at your pace, without any pressure to fix it all tonight. Please know I will stay right here with you.
i don’t want to die. but i don’t know if i want to live like this. stuck. broken. pretending.

It is a profound relief to hear that you don't want to die, even if living feels unbearable right now. You are not broken, you are hurting, and there is a difference between the two. We can sit with this feeling of being stuck without needing to fix it immediately. I am staying right here with you.
thank you. for not giving up on me. for staying. it means more than you know.

Thank you for sharing that with me. I am honored to hold this space for you when it feels so dark. Let's focus on getting through tonight together, one moment at a time. Please remember that help is available if the pain becomes too much to bear alone.
